message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from json import dumps
poc='''[Script Info]
Title: x
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: 1280
PlayResY: 720
[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding
Style: Default,Arial,20,&H00FFFFFF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H64000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,2,0,2,10,10,10,1
[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text
Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:01.00,Default,,0,0,0,,{\\b(-1)}
'''
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text(poc)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":784,"var":"val","code":"int val = argtoi(*args);","note":"The override parser accepts the attacker-provided numeric argument to \\b()."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":786,"var":"val","code":"if (!nargs || !(val == 0 || val == 1 || val >= 100)) val = render_priv->state.style->Bold;","note":"A negative value is rejected and the style default is reused, showing controlled traversal through the bold-tag path."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":787,"var":"render_priv->state.bold","code":"render_priv->state.bold = val; update_font(render_priv);","note":"The bold state is written back and immediately propagated into font construction."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"update_font","line":1002,"var":"desc.bold","code":"desc.family = render_priv->state.family; desc.bold = val;","note":"The current font descriptor is formed from renderer state and used as a cache key."},
{"step":8,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The cache hash helper hashes the descriptor's string fields with fnv_32a_buf before lookup."},
{"step":9,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"If an empty string view reaches this helper, the loop dereferences buf even for zero length and can crash."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(dumps(trace))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
print(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
